label: Updated 8 PM ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: CJ CUP Byron Nelson Leader
items.text: Si Woo Kim leads THE CJ CUP Byron Nelson at 18-under par, sitting five strokes ahead of Sungjae Im, Kensei Hirata, Scottie Scheffler, and Wyndham Clark at 13-under.

items.headline: Im's Hole-in-One and Eagle
items.text: Sungjae Im aced the par-3 7th hole and eagled the par-5 9th to reach 13-under, tying Kensei Hirata at THE CJ CUP Byron Nelson.

items.headline: Higgo Caddie Takes Blame
items.text: Garrick Higgo’s caddie admitted fault for a two-stroke penalty after Higgo arrived late and missed the PGA Championship cut by one stroke.
